name: @xpert-ai/plugin-maps
description: Interactive maps for Xpert with replaceable AMap and Tencent providers.

description.en_US: Search places, explore nearby results and plan routes in your Assistant's Workbench.
description.zh_Hans: 在助手工作台搜索地点、探索周边并规划路线。

icon.value: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"><path d="m3 6 6-3 6 3 6-3v15l-6 3-6-3-6 3zM9 3v15m6-12v15"/><circle cx="15" cy="9" r="2"/></svg>

tagline.en_US: Find your place. Plan your route.

description.en_US: Find places by city or map area, with linked map markers and result cards.
description.zh_Hans: 按城市或地图区域搜索地点，地图标记与结果卡片联动展示。

description.en_US: Inspect provider-supplied place details and add a place reference to your draft message.
description.zh_Hans: 查看地图服务提供的地点详情，将地点引用添加到对话草稿。

description.en_US: Plan a route between selected places and inspect its path, distance and duration.
description.zh_Hans: 在所选地点之间规划路线，查看路径、距离和预计时长。

dataScope.en_US: Map requests use the current Assistant's authorized workspace Connector. Queries and route coordinates are sent to the selected map provider; credentials remain on the server.
dataScope.zh_Hans: 地图请求使用当前助手已授权的工作空间连接器。查询与路线坐标发送至所选地图服务，凭据保留在服务端。

initializationSummary.en_US: Create a dedicated workspace and publish the live Maps Assistant. Before using real maps, connect and authorize AMap or Tencent Maps in the workspace.
initializationSummary.zh_Hans: 创建专用工作空间并发布正式地图助手。使用真实地图前，请在工作空间连接并授权高德地图或腾讯地图。

initializationSteps.en_US: Install the live Maps Assistant template
initializationSteps.zh_Hans: 安装正式地图助手模板
